en: Distilled volatile acid replaces your vital humors. Your strikes shatter stone with ferocious power, though your brittle shell can endure little punishment.
Grafted tendon from a swift sacrificial beast, woven into the vessel's stride to grant tireless speed across the arena.
Cooled furnace dross fused directly to the ribs, absorbing kinetic blows and turning aside the fiercest enemy strikes.
Refined quicksilver infused along the spinal conduit, sharpening synaptic reflexes so your arts can be invoked in rapid succession.
Alchemical bellows fitted to the core, stoking inner combustion to propel your rites swifter and engulf wider swaths of the horde.
Feathers sealed in consecrated sealing wax that insulate the vessel from boiling brimstone pools and caustic mire.
A living glass vessel engorged on distilled vitae. Steadies the vessel with ceaseless regeneration and prolongs your binding rites, but swells your frame into an easier target.
A dense sphere of alchemical lead settled in the vessel, firmly anchoring the animating humors against collapse.
Purified liquid argent that resonates with spilled essence, drawing distant mercury drops to your core and transmuting them into richer insight.
A heavy brass ocular bolted to the brow. Pinpoints fatal celestial fractures to trigger devastating critical strikes that hasten your rites, at the heavy cost of your stride.
Desiccates the vessel's silhouette into a compact, elusive form that slips cleanly between striking claws and projectiles.
An unforgiven heresy against the Great Work. Ignites your arts with catastrophic ruin against guardians and elite horrors, but renders your shell fragile and rejects ambient insight.
A vermilion leech sealed in amber glass. It drinks the lingering humors from slain enemies and siphons their vital essence into your vessel.
Clots of ash and failed calcination that skitter out of cracked retorts. Individually brittle, they swarm any warm vessel to strip its mercury.
Distended husks engorged on boiling sulfur. They circle the outer kiln perimeter, hurling globules of molten slag whenever a vessel slows its stride.
A heavy amalgam of cast-iron ribs and stoked furnace slag built to herd failed transmutations. It charges across the flagstones with crushing momentum.
The living furnace heart that consumed its own alchemists. It awakens only when the Transmutation Circle is charged, determined to melt every vessel back into raw clay.
Shards of alchemical salt and frozen mercury that skitter across the dockside stone. Quicker and harder than kiln mites, they hunt in tight, unforgiving packs.
Hollowed alembic creatures that siphon freezing brine from the dock fissures and spit high-velocity needles of rime across the chamber.
Heavy dockside hulks armored in glacier-thick salt plate and quenched iron. Their relentless charge shatters brittle vessels that linger along the canal.
An ancient transmutation frozen mid-ascension when the sea-locks broke. Crowned in pale rime, it crushes any vessel that dares open the deeper Rift.
Entombed at the bottom of the Great Work where heat and motion cease. It is the final seal-keeper; to shatter its glacial hull is to complete the transmutation.
A disembodied brass-and-aether eye that drifts at the edge of sight. It traces a thin celestial sightline before lancing the arena—only solid pillars can break its gaze.
Clay and quicksilver, stolen from a failed Great Work. You kite the dross until the seal holds.
A monk who walked into the kiln and did not burn. He draws circles the horde must not cross.
A needle of fire. It only flies where you point.
Fires searing bolts of flame toward your cursor.
The vessel slips between worlds for a breath.
Dash swiftly forward, phasing harmlessly through foes and projectiles.
A thin ray of stolen sky. Line them up or waste the breath.
Lances through every foe in a line, briefly steadying your stride.
A hammer of the Great Work, dropped where you will it.
Calls down a concentrated alchemical strike at the cursor after a brief delay.
Heavy glass, thrown in an arc. The air between you and the stain is empty.
Lobs a heavy censer over the horde that shatters on impact, scorching nearby foes.
A seam of sulfur drawn across the yard. The small ones fear it.
Draws a burning seam of sulfur that slows lesser foes crossing it.
Leave a husk of ash. The mites chase the ghost.
Dash to safety while leaving an ash effigy that lures lesser foes.
A chain for the proud. The small are ash before the iron locks.
Pierces and incinerates lesser foes to bind the first elite or boss struck with a searing chain.
The outer foundry where raw matter was burned to black ash. Obsidian kilns still vent superheated slag, and volatile brimstone urns litter the cracked flagstones.
A subterranean canal where alchemical salts and quicksilver were quenched in freezing brine. Frozen bollards block stray bolts while pressurized rime casks threaten to shatter in a numbing frost.
Final Chamber · Rubedo & The Great Seal
The deepest vault beneath the canal, sealed in eternal permafrost to contain the Frost Emperor. Here the Transmutation Circle demands the longest vigil before the Great Work is decided.
